footer.blurb: An independent coalition of mid-cap CEOs documenting the cumulative cost of EU regulation, one data point at a time.
footer.anonymousNote: Anonymous submissions are never attributed to a named company.

landing.subhead: Cumulative EU regulations are killing competitiveness. Join the movement measuring the real cost.
landing.ctaJoin: Join Free – Add Your Regulatory Pain
landing.noFees: No fees. No lobbying budget required. Anonymous option available.
landing.whyNowTitle: The window to change course is closing.
landing.whyNowLead: Three forces converged in the last 18 months. Together they make the cost of silence higher than the cost of speaking up.
landing.farmerBody: Tractors blocked Brussels, Paris and Berlin. Farmers proved that when the real economy pushes back together, the Commission listens. Mid-caps have not yet made their voice heard.
landing.greenBody: CSRD, CSDDD, EUDR, CBAM, the Taxonomy. Each rule alone is 'manageable'. Stacked together they consume entire finance and legal teams at companies that compete globally.
landing.mercosurBody: Trade deals open the door to competitors who face none of these obligations. Europe is exporting its industrial base while importing goods produced under lighter rules.
landing.howTitle: One number Brussels can't argue with.
landing.howLead: Anecdotes get dismissed. Aggregated, verifiable cost data from thousands of companies does not. ERBA turns your compliance headache into a line item on the political agenda.
landing.step1Body: Two minutes. Anonymous by default if you prefer.
landing.step2Body: Pick the regulation that hurts most and estimate the annual burden.
landing.step3Body: Your data feeds the public Pain Index that policymakers can't ignore.
landing.closeTitle: Your compliance cost is a political fact.
landing.closeLead: Join {count} companies already on the record. It takes less time than reading one CSRD disclosure requirement.

join.title: Put your compliance cost on the record.
join.lead: {count} companies have already documented {cost} in regulatory burden. Every new data point makes the number harder to dismiss.
join.twoMinBody: Three short steps. No documents required.
join.anonBody: Your cost counts; your company name can stay hidden.
join.neverBody: Data is aggregated for advocacy only, never shared with vendors.

painIndex.method: Methodology: figures are self-reported annual compliance cost estimates submitted by member companies. Company identities are never displayed; anonymous submissions are included in aggregates. Totals refresh every minute.
